scenes.basis: 26:1 "When Jesus had finished all these words" - the Olivet discourse (24:3) closes here, no movement
26:3 "the chief priests... were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas" - in Jerusalem (cf. 26:57)
26:6 "Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper"
26:14 "Judas Iscariot... went to the chief priests" - in Jerusalem (26:3-5)
26:18 "Go into the city to a certain person... I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples"
26:20 "when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve" - in the prepared house in the city (26:18)
26:30 "When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives"
26:36 "Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane"
26:47-56 the arrest - "they came and laid hands on Jesus" where he prayed (26:36)
26:57 "Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest"; Peter "entered in" to the court of the high priest
26:59-75 the trial before the council and Peter's denials in the court of the high priest (26:57-58)
